# Maurício Diogo Music

> Brazilian vocalist and multi-instrumentalist (vocals, guitar, chromatic harmonica, cello) performing 3+ hour live sets for cruise ships, luxury resorts, hotels and corporate events. Open to international contracts.

## Key facts
- Name: Maurício Diogo (brand: Maurício Diogo Music / Maurício Diogo Shows & Eventos)
- Format: solo live act with self-contained sound system
- Repertoire: Classic Rock, Pop Rock (The Beatles, Oasis, U2, Pink Floyd, Creedence, Bon Jovi and more), Country, Folk, Blues, Bossa Nova, MPB
- Based in: interior of São Paulo state, Brazil
- Languages: Portuguese (native), English songs and stage communication
- Booking: mau.fisicart@gmail.com | WhatsApp +55 19 97815-1307
